---
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r params$generated_on`"
output: 
  html_document:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
params:
  title: "MultiConnector Analysis Report"
  generated_on: !r Sys.time()
  report_data: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
report <- params$report_data
```

## Summary

This report provides a comprehensive overview of the MultiConnector analysis performed.

### Data Overview

```{r data_overview}
if (!is.null(report$summary$data_overview)) {
    summ <- report$summary$data_overview
    cat("The analysis included", summ$n_subjects, "subjects and", summ$n_measures, "measures.\n")
    cat("Total number of time points analyzed:", summ$n_timepoints, "\n")
    cat("Time range:", paste(summ$time_range, collapse = " to "), "\n")
    cat("Measures included:", paste(summ$measures, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis

### Time Series Plot

```{r timeseries_plot}
if (!is.null(report$plots$timeseries_plot)) {
    print(report$plots$timeseries_plot)
}
```

### Time Grid Visualization

```{r time_grid_plot}
if (!is.null(report$plots$time_grid_plot)) {
    print(report$plots$time_grid_plot)
}
```

```{r dimension_analysis, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(report$plots$dimension_analysis)) {
    cat("## Dimension Analysis\n")
    print(report$plots$dimension_analysis)
}
```

```{r clustering_analysis, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(report$summary$clustering_overview)) {
    cat("## Clustering Analysis\n")

    cat("### Clustering Summary\n")
    cat("- **Number of clusters:**", report$summary$clustering_overview$n_clusters, "\n")
    cat("- **H parameter:**", report$summary$clustering_overview$h_parameter, "\n")
    cat("- **Cluster names:**", paste(report$summary$clustering_overview$cluster_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")

    cat("\n### Cluster Assignments\n")
    if (!is.null(report$tables$cluster_assignments)) {
        print(knitr::kable(report$tables$cluster_assignments))
    }

    cat("\n### Cluster Visualizations\n")
    print(report$plots$cluster_plot_basic)
}
```

```{r feature_plots, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(report$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature) && length(report$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature) > 0) {
    cat("### Feature-based Visualizations\n")
    for (feat in names(report$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature)) {
        cat("#### Feature:", feat, "\n")
        print(report$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature[[feat]])
        cat("\n")
    }
}
```

```{r additional_analysis, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(report$plots$discriminant_plot)) {
    cat("### Discriminant Analysis\n")
    print(report$plots$discriminant_plot)
}

if (!is.null(report$plots$spline_plots)) {
    cat("### Spline Plots (Subject Examples)\n")
    # Print first 3 subject plots for brevity
    splines <- report$plots$spline_plots
    n_to_show <- min(3, length(splines))
    for (i in 1:n_to_show) {
        print(splines[[i]])
    }
}
```
